Living Room Design

We plan the layout first and style it second — seating, TV wall, storage, lighting and circulation designed together, so the room looks calm and works every day. Here is a sample living room, from floor plan to finished 3D views.

Layout

Floor Plan

Living Room — 13'1" x 16'10"

Planned around how you live

A 3-seater sofa sits under the window, with a 2-seater and a centre table facing the TV wall along the long side of the room.

  • Main door with a clear swing and open walking path
  • Storage unit with bench seat beside the entrance
  • Full-length TV unit along the right wall
  • Window seating that makes use of natural light
